record.question: The principle sources of the Jewish Medicine are the:
record.explanation: Answer A: Bible and Talmud. Historical accounts identify the Hebrew Bible and Talmud as principal textual sources for Jewish medicine; the broad phrase does not mean they are modern medical manuals. Source/context note: “Principal sources” is broad historical language; not a statement that these are the only sources. Reference: https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/articlepdf/610314/archopht_9_5_004.pdf?resultClick=1; https://www.nature.com/articles/156031a0. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
